official_sources.name: EA persistent WCS announcement and FAQ

direct_official_checks: DTM 1m WCS uses WCS 2.0.1 GetCapabilities endpoint
persistent endpoint is designed to survive annual data updates
NoData sentinel must not be treated as a valid elevation
coverage identifier must come from live service metadata/client discovery
axis labels must come from live service metadata rather than guessed names
quality_effect: Fail-closes numeric sampling on NoData or unverified coverage metadata.
